# Chapter 1
The derivative measures instantaneous rate of change.
$$ f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h} $$
| term | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| limit | approaching a value |

## Applications
Velocity is the derivative of position.
